title: A short note on Arthur parameters with singular orbit closures
summary: This short article resolves a question about Arthur parameters highlighted in previous work of Balodis, Cunningham, Fiori and Zhang, in the case of $\mathrm{GL}_n/F$ where $F/\mathbb{Q}_p$ is a $p$-adic field. Namely, we prove that every Arthur parameter $ψ$ of $\mathrm{GL}_n/F$, can be factored into Arthur parameters $ψ\cong ψ_1\oplus\cdots \oplusψ_r$ such that the orbit $C_ψ=C_{ψ_1}\times\cdots\times C_{ψ_r}\subseteq V_{λ_{ψ_1}}\times \cdots \times V_{λ_{ψ_r}}$ in the associated Vogan variety has smooth closure if and only if each $\bar{C}_{ψ_i}$ is smooth for $i=1, \ldots, r$, and that…
